scientific_integrity: Analytic proof supplies all-dimensional inequalities and parameter monotonicity; finite numerical scripts are regressions only. Source originality may be limited by unindexed Orlicz-norm calculations.
scientific_limitations: The facet-integral transition functional is studied for origin-centered parallelotopes; no assertion that the smooth-body covariogram limit theorem extends to polyhedral boundaries, nor any claim for general convex bodies. Independent audit not performed.
title: Exact Euclidean distance and scale monotonicity of log-cosh transition bodies of parallelotopes
